controlled_intent.premise_family: legacy-system dependency under live operational pressure
controlled_intent.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior station systems technician completing independent-watch qualification.
controlled_intent.inciting_pressure: A legacy service bus reports an intermittent thermal/power anomaly shortly before a docking and observation window overlap.
controlled_intent.central_uncertainty: The signal may indicate a real hidden dependency between a legacy module and active systems, or it may be faulty/ambiguous telemetry.
stakes: unnecessary isolation can interrupt active research or docking support
ignoring a real dependency can turn a localized maintenance anomaly into an operational failure
Arda’s judgment affects whether senior staff trust him with independent watch authority
must_offer_meaningful_branch_choice: physical trace through the service deck before changing live configuration
controlled_intent.branch_core_requirement: Each branch must produce a different kind of bounded evidence and operational consequence without proving the hidden dependency unless earned.
must_remain_unresolved_unless_earned: whether the legacy module is the true cause
whether the telemetry fault is repeatable
whether other legacy modules share the same hidden dependency
required_difference_from_control: no route advisory or harbor logistics
no recurrence-versus-repeatability as the primary dramatic distinction
